summary: Rencana implementasi solusi komprehensif untuk 4 celah teknis APK: (1) Anti-Deteksi Server TikTok via fragment shader OpenGL (micro-noise, color shift, micro-zoom), (2) Codec Guard & Pencegah Crash RAM 2600MB, (3) Multi-Heuristic Comment Parser kebal update UI TikTok, dan (4) LSPosed Health Guard & Cloaking.
